legalBasis: We use enquiry details to take steps at your request before entering into a contract and to respond to business enquiries under our legitimate interest in communicating with prospective customers. We do not automatically subscribe website enquirers to marketing emails.
retention: Enquiries marked as not proceeding are deleted, together with their associated notes and activity, after 30 days through scheduled cleanup. Active enquiries are kept while discussions continue. Records needed for an agreed project, accounting or a legal obligation are handled separately; this 30-day policy applies to unsuccessful enquiries.
transferArrangements: The website is hosted by Netlify. Website enquiries and dashboard authentication are handled by Supabase, with the project database in the London region (eu-west-2). Hosting, authentication, support and other provider operations may involve processing outside the UK. Where applicable, provider data-processing terms and recognised transfer safeguards apply. Database region alone does not mean that all provider processing stays in the UK.
